abstract: The Mediator complex bridges transcription factors and the basal transcription machinery to precisely regulate gene expression. Here, we identified SLBA1, which encodes the mediator subunit OsMED16, as a pleiotropic regulator of lesion mimic formation, branch development, and grain size in rice. OsMED16 acts as a "Goldilocks" protein with a strict dosage effect: complete loss of function or excessive overexpression causes lethality, while partial dysfunction or high overexpression triggers spontaneous cell death. Only optimal expression ensures normal growth. Natural variation and genetic analyses confirmed its role in grain size control. Mechanistically, OsMED16 physically interacts with the transcription factor OsKNAT7, which differentially modulates two NAC partners, repressing the transcriptional activation activity of OsNAC31 while enhancing that of OsNAC24. Through this interaction, OsMED16 suppresses the OsKNAT7-OsNAC24 module, thereby modulating the expression of key grain-size regulators GW2, GW5, and D11. Intriguingly, the OsMED16 promoter contains adjacent binding motifs for OsKNAT7 and OsNAC31. OsNAC31 serves as the primary activator of OsMED16 transcription, whereas OsKNAT7 plays a dual role by weakly activating it while antagonizing OsNAC31-mediated activation. OsNAC24 further fine-tunes OsMED16 expression via the OsKNAT7-OsNAC31 cascade. This forms an auto-regulatory feedback loop wherein OsMED16 modulates its own expression by repressing OsNAC31 through OsKNAT7-OsNAC31 module. Remarkably, field trials showed that moderate OsMED16 overexpression simultaneously enhances blast resistance and increases grain yield. This study provides insights into the dosage-dependent functions of the mediator complex and offers valuable genetic resources for the synergistic improvement of yield and resistance in rice breeding.

summary: Rice OsMED16 mediator subunit shows dosage-dependent control of grain size and blast resistance via an OsKNAT7-OsNAC31/24 feedback circuit; wet-lab study.
title: From lethality to yield: The "Goldilocks" protein OsMED16 orchestrates grain size and its own dosage via an OsKNAT7-OsNAC31/24 circuit.
